name: CLOCKWATCHING
source:
As an employee of an unremarkable supermarket chain... Your coworker "Feather Face" (Otherwise known as Ted) has always been sort of... Well, weird.

Watch the clock, go through the daily motions, decide whether to talk to him. It's all in a day's work here. Although... Today feels different. 

[From [url=https://tokipetal.itch.io/clockwatching]itch.io[/url]]
